articles.headline: 2026 World Cup live updates: Mexico vs. South Africa

articles.headline: Thomas Tuchel: 'Nothing changes' if Elliot Anderson makes big-money Man City move
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has said Elliot Anderson is the "full package" and the England boss does not believe a potential big money move to Manchester City would change the Nottingham Forest star.
